A home for trying `migrate-memory` by hand: one fact in a source of each supported agent, plus what must be left alone.
Copy this folder somewhere, point HOME at the copy, set up petit-poucet there and ask the agent to migrate memory from `app/`.
Expected: five notes proposed (commit messages, shell indentation, staging server, test suite, small modules), nothing saved before
confirmation; the petit-poucet line, the build command and `raw_memories.md` left out.
